subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should Telegram ignored-abort recovery release same-lane updates only after a hard handler-death or process-restart boundary, and should this issue remain the canonical persistent forum-topic investigation until that proof exists?
rationale: The issue combines a source-proven guarded-lane failure with field evidence of a durable per-topic black hole after full restarts, so choosing the recovery boundary and proof bar is a maintainer reliability decision rather than a safe automated patch choice.

options.title: Keep Separate With Hard-Boundary Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof that fresh non-reply topic messages recover only after the previous handler is actually dead.

options.title: Fold Into Guarded-Lane Work After Proof
options.body: Treat the linked guarded-lane work as canonical only if maintainers confirm it explains the post-restart forum-topic symptom and the final PR proves that case.

options.title: Accept TTL-Style Lane Release
options.body: Allow a timeout-only release path as an intentional mitigation while accepting the risk of concurrent same-lane handlers and ordering drift.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate With Hard-Boundary Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof that fresh non-reply topic messages recover only after the previous handler is actually dead.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior isolated-ingress, reply-fence, and spool recovery work is the strongest owner trail for the recovery boundary at issue.
